name: Free shipping starts at exactly $50.00
description: Two Stoneware Bowls ($50.00) must ship free; one bowl must not.

planSteps.description: On the shop page, click "Add to cart" for Stoneware Bowl twice
Click the Cart link in the store header
The Shipping row reads Free and the Total row reads exactly $50.00
Click the minus button on the Stoneware Bowl line once
The Shipping row now reads $6.00 and the Total row reads exactly $31.00
